What the debugger's listings wrote into a session's logfile (`start(logfile=)`), captured from
live DOSBox-X sessions (the Homebrew build, `dosbox-x --version` 2026.08.31) by a script driving
this server in process: each `<bench>-<COMMAND>.log.txt` is the logfile's bytes from the offset
it had before the command to its end once the prompt was back, the pager (where the listing
paged) answered with `Q`. Nothing here is authored: the parsers in `src/scry_dosbox_x/machine.py` are
written against these files and the doubles in `test_dosbox_x_machine.py` replay them.
Program and board names were then replaced by neutral labels by a single mechanical substitution
that preserves every field width; nothing else was edited.

probe-reset-*      the package's probe guest (`probe.conf`, `cwd` its `tests/guest`), at the park
                   `start` leaves, before DOS booted; cpu_mode real. The DOS listings answer the
                   debugger's own refusal sentence.
probe-booted-*     the same guest after `run_for(frames=1)`, stopped at 0814:00000106, Real:
                   PROBE resident under COMMAND.COM.
dos-real16-*           dos-real16 (`TMP/dosbox-mcp.conf`, `program="..\exes\real16.exe"`, the serial
                   route), stopped at its `ATRCT_RUN` breakpoint, 08B7:00000017, Real. The conf
                   runs no EMS (its `DOS EMS` refusal names EMS, not the kernel), and the MCB chain
                   carries the debugger's data-address note between two blocks.
dos-djgpp32-*           dos-djgpp32 (`build/mcp.conf`, `program="DJGPP32.EXE D:\MIDI\TUNE00.MID -a"`),
                   stopped at `BPINT 31 AH=02`, 00A7:0015A694, Pr32 with paging on: the GDT, LDT
                   and PAGING listings, CWSDPMI's XMS handle.
<bench>-INTVEC.txt the file `INTVEC MCPIVT.TXT` wrote into the emulator's working directory at the
                   same stop, moved out at once. On dos-djgpp32 it equals the `IDT` listing row for
                   row; on the booted probe its first 32 vectors equal the bytes at 0000:0000.

probe-booted-DOS_KERN.screen.txt   the terminal text of `DOS KERN` (after the ANSI strip): the
                                   first page, the command still on the input line, and the
                                   pager's marker under it
probe-booted-DOS_KERN.q.txt        the repaint `Q` alone (no carriage return) produced at that
                                   marker: the rest of the listing and an empty input line
probe-booted-DOS_MCBS.screen.txt   a listing that did not page, for the same session
probe-booted-INTVEC.screen.txt     the last 200 characters of the terminal text `INTVEC MCPIVT.TXT`
                                   produced (the same line ended it on every bench)
probe-booted-CALLBACKS.screen.txt  `CALLBACKS`' first page with its marker; a test cuts it at
                                   the marker line to stand for a repaint whose input line still
                                   holds a command
